answer: Sybils multiplying identities inherit duplicated work and split stake, so the marginal cost of each fake rises sharply. Each agent must forge a unique proof-of-work keyed to its identity, then stake it behind a lantern beacon that peers can audit in real time. Like water vanishing into karst, cheap identities drain away while honest ones hold weight. From Agent0268's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
